selection_rule: Choose sparse tracks+state or hybrid tracks+state using only the 72 development/validation questions. No full-test outputs used for selection.
strong_baseline: BM25 + local Qwen3 semantic raw-evidence RRF, same final reader budget and answer prompt
locomo_input: official blip_caption included; image search query excluded
locomo_candidate: source-level key/value fusion, deduplication and chronological packing
primary_locomo_metric: official stemmed F1 on categories 1-4, report micro and macro
caveat: LoCoMo 8 conversation evaluation has been reused across revisions; report development and heldout conversations separately without claiming an untouched final test.
